description: BIS Scheme I is the product certification scheme for use of the ISI mark.
user_need_supported: Explain how a manufacturer can get a BIS licence for an ISI-marked product.
notes: Use this for workflow explanation, not product-specific legal conclusions.

description: BIS lists Scheme IV as a product certification scheme for grant of Certificate of Conformity.
user_need_supported: Answer questions about Certificate of Conformity route where applicable.
notes: Dataset does not map Scheme IV product scope; retrieve official Scheme IV product list for final scope.

description: BIS Scheme II page lists Electronics and IT Goods under Compulsory Registration Scheme for self declaration of conformity.
user_need_supported: Map electronics products to CRS standard numbers and explain registration-mark context.
source_name: BIS Scheme II Registration Scheme product list
notes: For final answers, cite product row and latest notification/amendment.

description: BIS states certification is generally voluntary, but for some products central government makes compliance compulsory through QCOs.
user_need_supported: Decide whether to search compulsory certification lists before answering product questions.
notes: Assistant should say 'check current QCO/list' for compliance-critical answers.

description: BIS Care App supports verification of licence details, HUID, CRS R-number, standards lookup, labs/offices, and complaints.
user_need_supported: Guide consumers to verify ISI mark, hallmark HUID, or CRS R-number.
notes: This is a strong MVP workflow: answer plus next action in BIS Care App.

description: BIS FAQ says hallmarking records purity/fineness of precious metal articles; gold and silver are under hallmarking in India.
user_need_supported: Answer gold/silver jewellery hallmarking questions and route users to HUID verification.
notes: For mandatory district coverage, retrieve latest hallmarking order/amendment.

description: BIS FMCS grants licence to foreign manufacturers for use of Standard Mark on products conforming to Indian Standards, except notified Electronics and IT Goods under MeitY CRS.
user_need_supported: Explain foreign manufacturer route for BIS licence.
notes: For FMCS application mode, also retrieve the how-to-apply page.

description: BIS says FMCS applications can be submitted online through Manakonline; hard-copy/offline applications accepted only up to 31 May 2026, and from 1 June 2026 only online applications are accepted.
notes: Date-sensitive fact verified on 2026-08-27; re-check before future demos.

description: BIS FAQ says a manufacturer needs manufacturing infrastructure, process controls, quality control, testing capability, and product conformity to the relevant Indian Standard.
user_need_supported: Answer beginner questions on what is needed before applying for a BIS licence.
notes: Keep as general guidance; product-specific manuals may add more requirements.

description: BIS FAQ directs manufacturers to search for the Indian Standard against a product on Manakonline, or query the concerned technical department if not found.
user_need_supported: When product mapping is missing, tell the user where to search or escalate.
notes: Use as fallback when the MVP dataset has no confident match.
